component: Calendar time-zone dialog overlay selector contract

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The overlay CSS now hides the highlighter by default and reveals explicit six-digit offset selectors. The accepted UTC branch and initial markup still use +0000, which differs from the +000000 selector. The comm offset serializer permits values with or without seconds, so six digits cannot be assumed for every producer. This is a static producer/selector mismatch, not an observed rendering failure or a diagnosis of all time-zone data.
title: The time-zone overlay's six-digit selectors differ from its explicit UTC value
